name: B10-0359/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep helping Moldova defend itself against Russian interference. It condemns Russian cyberattacks, disinformation and attempts to influence Moldovan elections. It asks the European Commission to report on whether earlier support for Moldova worked, to keep funding independent media and civil society, and to push Moldova's EU membership talks forward. It also asks Moldova to update its digital laws. The text is a statement of position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the Commission to act and report back.
- **Who it affects:** Moldova, its media and civil society, online platforms, and EU institutions.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to report on support results and keep assisting Moldova.
